resources.string: Block ads across all apps and browsers with one tap. Uses DNS filtering technology — no root required.\n\n🔒 Privacy promise: We never collect, store, or transmit your browsing data. All processing happens on your device only.
Select how aggressively you want to block ads and trackers
Block major ad networks. Minimal impact on website functionality.
Block ads, trackers, and analytics. Good balance of protection and compatibility.
Maximum blocking. May affect some website functionality but provides the strongest protection.
Select a DNS server for resolving domain names. You can change this later in Settings.
BlockAds uses a local VPN to filter DNS queries and block ads. No data leaves your device — this VPN only works locally to intercept and filter DNS requests.
Allow notifications to see real-time blocking statistics and know when your protection is active. Required for the persistent VPN notification on Android 13+.
Exclude BlockAds from battery optimization so the VPN service stays active in the background and doesn\'t get killed by the system.
Congratulations! BlockAds is configured and ready to protect your device from ads and trackers.

BlockAds is completely privacy-first. We would like your permission to collect anonymous crash reports to help us fix bugs promptly.\n\nThis is strictly OPT-IN, contains NO personal identifiable information (PII), and can be disabled anytime in Settings.
